sloka: राघवस्य कुले जातैरुदधिः परिवर्धितः ।स त्वां रामहिते युक्तं प्रत्यर्चयति सागरः ॥५-१-११३॥
transliteration: rāghavasya kule jātairudadhiḥ parivardhitaḥ ।sa tvāṁ rāmahite yuktaṁ pratyarcayati sāgaraḥ ॥5-1-113॥

translations.english: "The son of Rama's family, Sagara, has extended the ocean in the past.It is most appropriate that he (the god of the sea) honours you in return as you have set out in the service of Rama.
